newsitem.title: INDIA: India Indo Gulf starts copper rod plant.
newsitem.headline: India Indo Gulf starts copper rod plant.

text.p: Indo Gulf Fertilisers and Chemicals Corp Ltd said on Monday it had commissioned a continuous copper rod plant.

"Forming part of the 18.5 billion rupee mega greenfield copper smelting and refining complex being set up at Dahej in Gujarat, this state-of-art plant has a capacity of 80,000 tonnes a year of copper rod," it said in a statement.
The plant has been built in technical collaboration with Southwire of U.S., it said.
Geared to produce rods of 8 mm diamter onwards, it is the only plant of its kind in India equipped to produce 19-mm diameter rods.
It will cater mainly to the electrical and telecommunications sector, including railway electrification, jelly-filled telephone cables, winding wires and transformers, it said.
Indo Gulf, part of the Aditya Birla Group, is a major fertiliser manufacturer.
